messages.subject: CALV-0140 - documents we need
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear David,

Good to meet you. To get the letter before action right, please could you let me have:

- the framework supply agreement with Ferncliffe (14 March 2022);
- the four purchase orders (PO-2024-0112/0188/0241/0307);
- the mill test certificates for heats H-4471, H-4472 and H-4488;
- the full Wraysbury report and the underlying test data;
- your goods-inwards inspection records for the affected deliveries; and
- the recall cost records and the Wexbourne termination letter.

No rush on all of it at once - the certificates and the report are the priority.

Tom Gallagher
Associate, Dispute Resolution
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0148

Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: CALV-0140 - documents we need
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Most of it is in the shared folder now. Two points: (1) the Wraysbury report is the 5 September version, which is final; (2) our goods-inwards records only show the dimensional and certificate checks - we don't do chemical analysis on certified bar, which I expect Ferncliffe will try to make something of. Happy to explain why that's normal for a fastener maker.

David
